name: Barotrauma
description: Co-op submarine survival horror on Europa. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: Game port (UDP)
variables.description: Must match the port in serversettings.xml (default 27015).

notes: All server settings (name, password, ports, max players) live in serversettings.xml, generated on first start — edit it in the file manager and restart. The server console accepts commands on stdin (help, save, shutdown). Windows hosts: set the start command override to DedicatedServer.exe.
